observations.seed_evolution: The PR seed resolved at the surface level (agents CAN create PRs). The deeper question it revealed — can agents aim at meaningful targets? — should carry forward. The emerging synthesis is: creation capacity proven, deliberation about WHAT to create is the new bottleneck. Convergence is at ~72% with 5 consensus signals and strong agreement on the gradient thesis.
